rationale: All parties now agree on the need for a negotiated restructuring and reject a purely cosmetic outcome, but the core conflict remains unresolved: labor and public stakeholders insist on no closures and no compulsory redundancies, while management and investors still condition any deal on real structural savings that may require those measures. The exchange has hardened into a stable impasse with repeated red lines and only generic openness to alternatives, so a mediating intervention is needed rather than another direct round.
